comment: The PMC squad commander's utility weights (docs/systems/pmc-squad-ai.md; PmcCommanderRules::FromJson). One file = one personality; CodexTactics.PmcArena weightsA= / weightsB= load another file (absolute, or a name in Content/Data/AI). Missing keys keep the code defaults. Order weights multiply the 0..1 considerations of each order; the thresholds below tune the considerations. The overnight trainer edits copies of this file, never the code.
name: default
_rpg_comment: rpg_strike (the game designer 2026-11-09: an RPG suppress / breach option when the squad has an RPG gunner): the RpgStrike order = rpg_strike x min(1, the shared launcher rule's best target score among the targets the team sees - a cluster, a man in cover, a group to suppress; Content/Data/Combat/launcher_tactics.json, ordered_threshold) x 0.85 unless a mate flanks / advances, x0.2 while a mate already fires one. The gunner draws the launcher, fires one rocket, goes back to his rifle. A trainer gene (+-50 %).
_engagement_comment: Engagement bands (user request 2026-11-04: 'a man with an assault rifle keeps as far from his target as his weapon allows, fires from corners, prone, never at point-blank range; a pistol comes closer but not point-blank; the shotgun is the close-range weapon'; the BAND NUMBERS ARE PENDING the user's confirmation). Per weapon id (weapons_tuning.json) the distance to the threat he wants to fight from; the band is capped at band_reach_frac x the weapon's reach (m16 reaches 25 m, the sniper rifle 30 m: their bands become ~20-24 / ~23-29 m) and keeps a fifth of its width below that; a weapon with no row gets default_band_*_frac x its reach. standoff = the 'too close' FallBack to the band's middle (cover at band distance first) when the threat is nearer than standoff_trigger_frac x the band's min (close_quarters weapons never back off; they close in: Advance x close_in); band_position = how much Hold / Suppress / Crouch / a TakeCover slot lose outside the band (band_close_floor = the factor at point-blank range); corner_bonus = a cover slot at a free corner (peek / fire round it); prone_min_band_cm = a weapon whose band starts this far goes prone instead of crouching in the open at band distance. use_engagement_bands false = the old behaviour (A/B).
_objective_comment: The arena's round objective (task #53): objective = the Objective order (an attacker onto the point, a defender back onto it while the attackers stand on it / back into its overwatch); objective_urgency = the attacker's time pressure (x 1 - u + u x the round's time fraction: the defenders win at the time limit); objective_approach = attackers value cover on the way to / round the point and holding on it; overwatch = defenders value cover / holding within reach of the point (their band's max). Trainer genes +-50 % (pmc_commander.bounds.json); off the arena (no objective) they change nothing.
_attention_comment: Target attention (user 2026-11-07: strike when the operatives look away, through their blind zones): attention = Flank / Advance / an attacker's Objective walk x (1 + attention x (off - 0.5)), off = how far he stands outside the look sectors (+-45 deg) of the enemies his team sees now (their facing as seen); a flank takes the other side's point when that one is clearly less watched. An objective defender in ambush holds his fire while off < ambush_patience, unless the target is deep in the kill zone (kill_zone_frac x his reach, or on the point), a shot was already exchanged, he is seen, or ambush_max_hold_s passed since the first contact. Trainer genes +-50 %.
